listing.name: Useful.Tithes 1.0.a
listing.summary: A small mod making pather tithes more useful.
listing.aiSummary: Makes paying tithes to Luddic Path fleets stop harassment from all Path fleets in the star system for a duration.

description:
A small mod making pather tithes more useful.

Paying tithes to a luddic path fleet causes all pather fleets in the star system to stop harassing you for a while, including newly spawned fleets and any fleets entering the system.
